fnol_text: My name is Leila Zielinski and I live at 161 Linden Terrace, Riverton, WY 82521. You can reach me on (555) 943-1319 or leila.zielinski@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 10 July 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00071. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Zielinski on (555) 943-1319 to acknowledge the claim. Leila confirmed the loss date as 10 July 2025.
Site visit to 161 Linden Terrace. Neighbour Amara Pereira was present and confirmed the timeline.
Leila sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
